name: 90814 · Long Beach, CA
findings: ZIP 90814 (Long Beach) has 83 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90814 (Long Beach) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90814 (Long Beach) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
